Year Šulgi the king of Ur, king of the four quarters, built the cattle barn of Puzriš-Dagan. (Sigrist & Damerow, *Mesopotamian Year Names* ..., p. 23)

In other words, he didn’t build a city, he built a barn, and there is an important matter that must be paid attention to and emphasized, which is that Puzriš-Dagan never attached the ki sign used for cities in this archive and in the rule of Šulgi, as well as in the era of Šulgi.
